question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To spill the beans
solution:
The correct answer is "**To give away a secret**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of a given idiom is '**To give away a secret.**' 
 
• The **idiom** means a collection of words that have been proven by usage to have a meaning apart from the meanings of the individual terms.
 
• *She **spilled the beans** out of excitement and the birthday party surprise was ruined*.
 
 
• This means she **gave away the secret **of the birthday out of excitement and the surprise was ruined.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A phrase or expression that has a meaning that cannot be understood by defining the individual words is known as an **idiom**. 
 
• Here are some examples of idioms.
 
 
• **Leave no stone unturned.**
 
 
• ​​This means to try in all possible if you what something.
 
 
 
• **Let the cat out of the bag. **
 
 
• ​​This means to spoil the secret.
 
 
 
• **To make a long story short.**
 
 
• ​This means come to a point/say in short.
